denominator_policy: global candidate-equivalent denominator = ADMITTED_EXECUTABLE V3 candidates + inherited V1/V2 lineage; rejected-pre-outcome specs never inflate it; frozen before outcome evaluation.

hierarchical_error_control.consistency_rule: a candidate is significant only if it passes candidate-, family-, domain- and global-level control simultaneously
hierarchical_error_control.domain_level: BH-FDR across family-level gatekeeper p-values within a domain
hierarchical_error_control.family_level_gatekeeper: Romano-Wolf step-down within family; family eligible only if >=1 candidate significant at family FWER
hierarchical_error_control.global_level: White Reality Check + Hansen SPA over the full admitted candidate matrix; global FWER bound over the frozen denominator

seed_policy: all randomness seeded by a frozen per-test integer seed; no wall-clock
